topics.name: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines: History & People

questions.q: What is the capital of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines?
questions.why: It is called the 'City of Arches'.

questions.q: Which volcano on St Vincent erupted in 2021?
questions.why: About 20,000 people had to leave.

questions.q: From which country did it gain independence in 1979?
questions.why: It is a Commonwealth realm.

questions.q: What currency is used in Saint Vincent and the Grenadines?
questions.why: It is shared by eight territories.

questions.q: Which film series was partly shot on St Vincent?
questions.why: Wallilabou Bay was a main set.

questions.q: Which people of African and Kalinago descent fought the British here?
questions.why: Many were exiled to Central America.

questions.q: Which island in the Grenadines is a celebrity hideaway?
questions.why: Princess Margaret had a house there.

questions.q: Which Garifuna chief is the national hero?
questions.why: He died fighting the British in 1795.

questions.q: Who has been Prime Minister since 2001?
questions.why: He is called 'Comrade Ralph'.

questions.q: Who was the first Prime Minister after independence?
questions.why: He served until 1984.

questions.q: Which island were the Garifuna exiled to in 1797?
questions.why: They later spread along the Central American coast.

questions.q: Which plant was brought to St Vincent by Captain Bligh in 1793?
questions.why: A tree from that voyage still grows there.

questions.q: Which botanical garden is the oldest in the Americas?
questions.why: It was founded in 1765.

questions.q: Which 1902 eruption killed about 1,600 people on St Vincent?
questions.why: Mount Pelée on Martinique erupted the next day.

questions.q: Who became Prime Minister of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines in 2025?
questions.why: The New Democratic Party won the election.

topics.name: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines: Places & Culture

questions.q: Which islands of the Grenadines are a famous sailing spot?
questions.why: Sea turtles swim in the lagoon.

questions.q: Which island has the Easter Regatta and a whaling tradition?
questions.why: It is the largest of the Grenadines.

questions.q: Which carnival is held in Kingstown in summer?
questions.why: It is held in late June and early July.

questions.q: Which national dish is roasted breadfruit and fried fish?
questions.why: Breadfruit came with Captain Bligh.

questions.q: Which root crop does St Vincent export a lot of?
questions.why: It is used in medicine and food.

questions.q: Which colourful parrot is St Vincent's national bird?
questions.why: It lives in the rainforest.

questions.q: Which ocean lies to the east of St Vincent?
questions.why: The Caribbean is to the west.

questions.q: Which fort above Kingstown is named after Queen Charlotte?
questions.why: It was built in 1806.

questions.q: Which waterfall is the highest on St Vincent?
questions.why: It is a twin waterfall.

questions.q: Which new international airport opened in 2017?
questions.why: It replaced E.T. Joshua.

questions.q: Which tiny Grenadines island is home to Salt Whistle Bay?
questions.why: It is one of the smallest lived-on islands.

questions.q: Which Grenadines island is the southern port of entry with a kite-surfing lagoon?
questions.why: Clifton is its main town.

questions.q: Which animal may Bequia's traditional whalers still hunt?
questions.why: A few may be taken each year.

questions.q: Which island in the Grenadines is privately owned and called Prune Island?
questions.why: An American couple renamed it.

questions.q: Which steel pan style competition is held at Vincy Mas?
questions.why: Steel bands compete.
